title: Door obstruction / reopen loop
symptoms: Doors reopen repeatedly; slow door close
probable_causes: Dirty sill track; misaligned light curtain; worn door rollers
fix_steps: Clean sill and track | Check light-curtain alignment and wiring | Inspect door rollers and gibs, replace if worn | Run 20 door cycles to confirm
parts: Door rollers; door gibs; light curtain

title: Floor leveling error
symptoms: Car stops above/below floor level; trip hazard
probable_causes: Encoder drift; worn sheave grooves; rope stretch
fix_steps: Re-learn floor positions (leveling calibration) | Check encoder coupling and signal | Inspect sheave grooves and rope tension

title: Brake response delay
symptoms: Brake monitor reports slow lift/drop; jerky stops
probable_causes: Worn brake linings; incorrect air gap; weak brake coil
fix_steps: Measure brake air gap and adjust | Inspect linings, replace if below minimum | Test brake coil resistance | Perform brake torque test

title: Drive overcurrent (VFD fault)
symptoms: Drive trips during acceleration; car stops mid-run
probable_causes: Overload; failing IGBT; motor insulation breakdown
fix_steps: Read VFD fault log | Megger-test motor windings | Check DC bus capacitors and IGBTs | Verify load weighing calibration

title: Controller program malfunction (watchdog reset)
symptoms: Controller reboots; car stuck; possible passenger entrapment
probable_causes: Firmware fault; corrupted parameters; failing CPU board
fix_steps: Dispatch emergency rescue if passengers trapped | Put car out of service | Download controller logs | Reflash firmware and restore parameters | Replace CPU board if fault repeats

title: Door operator failure
symptoms: Doors will not open/close; car out of service
probable_causes: Door motor burnout; broken belt; failed door controller
fix_steps: Isolate car | Replace door operator motor or belt | Replace door controller if faulty | Adjust door speed profiles | Safety test before return to service
parts: Door operator motor; door belt; door controller

title: Traction motor / bearing failure
symptoms: Grinding noise; high vibration; motor will not run
probable_causes: Bearing wear; winding failure; misalignment
fix_steps: Isolate car and secure counterweight | Replace motor bearings or motor | Laser-align motor and gearbox | Vibration test after repair

title: Brake assembly failure
symptoms: Brake fails to hold or release; car out of service
probable_causes: Worn linings; failed solenoid; spring fatigue
fix_steps: Isolate car and secure | Replace brake linings / solenoid / springs | Set air gap | 125% load brake test

title: Controller / drive failure
symptoms: Controller dead; no dispatch; drive fault lockout
probable_causes: Power surge; board failure; overheating
fix_steps: Isolate car | Replace failed controller board or drive | Restore parameters from backup | Full functional and safety test

title: Motor supply voltage abnormal
symptoms: Rolling-average motor voltage above historical limits
probable_causes: Supply fluctuation; failing door operator drawing excess current
fix_steps: Check supply voltage at main disconnect | Inspect door operator current draw | Tighten terminals; check for overheating

title: Motor speed low
symptoms: Rolling-average motor RPM below historical limits
probable_causes: Bearing drag; overload; drive tuning drift
fix_steps: Check motor bearings for noise/heat | Verify drive speed tuning | Inspect for mechanical drag

title: Brake pressure high
symptoms: Rolling-average brake pressure above historical limits
probable_causes: Sticking brake; incorrect spring setting
fix_steps: Inspect brake for drag | Re-set brake spring tension | Check hydraulic/brake lines

title: Car vibration high
symptoms: Rolling-average car vibration above historical limits
probable_causes: Guide-rail misalignment; worn guide shoes; drive instability
fix_steps: Inspect guide shoes/rollers | Check rail alignment and fixings | Tune drive gains

title: Door mechanism vibration high
symptoms: Door ball-bearing vibration above historical limits
probable_causes: Worn door bearings; loose hanger; track debris
fix_steps: Clean and lubricate door track | Replace door hanger bearings | Tighten hanger fixings

title: Abnormal machine sound
symptoms: Acoustic signature differs from healthy baseline
probable_causes: Bearing wear; cavitation in hydraulic pump; loose parts
fix_steps: Listen on site and locate source | Inspect motor/pump bearings | Check mountings and fasteners | Re-record after repair

title: Rope / sheave wear limit
symptoms: Wear counter beyond limit; rope slip risk
probable_causes: Long operating time since last rope service
fix_steps: Measure rope diameter and elongation | Inspect sheave grooves | Replace ropes if beyond discard criteria

title: Motor overheating
symptoms: Motor temperature close to ambient limit; heat dissipation failure
probable_causes: Blocked ventilation; machine room too hot; low speed with high torque
fix_steps: Check machine-room cooling/ventilation | Clean motor fan and fins | Verify thermal sensor | Reduce duty cycle until fixed

title: Drive power fault
symptoms: Power outside safe band (too low or too high)
probable_causes: Supply problem; drive tuning; mechanical binding
fix_steps: Check supply phases and voltage | Inspect drive power stage | Check for mechanical binding

title: Overload / overstrain
symptoms: Repeated runs above rated load
probable_causes: Car overloaded; load weighing device mis-calibrated
fix_steps: Calibrate load-weighing device | Enable/verify overload buzzer and door hold | Inspect motor and ropes for strain

title: Random drive trip
symptoms: Unexplained trip with no clear cause
probable_causes: Transient electrical noise; loose connector
fix_steps: Review logs around event | Re-seat connectors | Monitor for recurrence
